item.title: October 20, 2026: 50-Gal Hybrid Heat Pump vs. Gas Tankless vs. Standard Electric Tank: 10-Year Operating Math
item.description: Counter-Intuitive Takeaway: A 199,000 BTU gas tankless retrofit requires upsizing existing 1/2-inch black iron gas pipe to 3/4-inch and running new Category III/IV PVC venting ($1,100–$1,600 in hidden rough-in labor), whereas a Hybrid Heat Pump Water Heater claims up to $2,000 in Section 25C tax credits and drops annual electric consumption from ~4,500 kWh to ~1,150 kWh.
